nodes.label: Depth-parity evaluation bug
nodes.contributor: evaluate() scored from a fixed root-mover perspective while negamax negates each ply; at odd depths the frontier was scored from the wrong side, inverting the value. Fixed by evaluating from the side to move: evaluate(st, st.to_move=='X', w).

nodes.label: Random-opponent benchmark methodology
nodes.contributor: Each config plays fixed games vs random, alternating first mover to remove first-move bias; metric win-rate = (wins+0.5*draws)/games.
